state.units: relative dry mass; metres; physical seconds; authored m2/reference-mass optical profiles. NOT calibrated kg/PM.
limits: no age deletion; no deposition/domain/RH chemistry implemented
uniform piecewise-held wind and prescribed thermal/diffusion surrogate; no Navier-Stokes or shear
same-profile capacity merges conserve instantaneous spatial moments; no velocity/thermal variance or position-velocity cross covariance, so future heterogeneous thermal separation is not preserved
sampled peak/column diagnostics are not global optical bounds; differential-thermal-travel gate only limits preferred merges
forcedMerges signal visual approximation, not an accepted appearance
no camera/P/C/UTC or renderer dependency
erf columns have finite numerical approximation error; not an unbiased ray renderer
pending queues, profiles and recent merge log are bounded; no retained old source/active-event archive

events.units: authored reference dry extinction area / relative mass units at a unit reference optical coefficient; NOT measured kg/PM, audio energy or explosive yield
limits: CPU adapter only; no main/render/physics/audio integration
9 bounded source means/SPD Gaussian kernels; Gaussian spatial support itself is infinite
mass conserved by downstream state, no age fade/deletion or deposited-mass model here
temperature excess, initial buoyancy, source spread and isotropic kernel sizes are authored surrogates, not CFD
completed drain world position is authoritative; no source relocation to current frame/camera
stage complete batches before flush, then advance state; equal-time events created after flush use arrival-order tie ordering
bounded identity storage never silently evicts same-watermark events; capacity rejects new input
clearForState replaces caller-cleared state, retains IDs/tombstones, no old event replay
state queue failure can be partial and is explicit/fault-locked until clearForState; caller must size queues/profiles before integration

columns.mediumDomain: unbounded full-SPD Gaussian; no halfspace, ground absorption or physical packet deletion
columns.omissionBound: Each missed 5-sigma AABB: sum M*trace(invSigma)/(2pi)*max(extinctionRGB)*exp(-12.5); only omitted when cumulative upper bound <= budget.
columns.numericMethod: binary64 Cholesky whitening + erf series/continued fraction + close-endpoint four-node quadrature
columns.units: metres, relative dry mass, authored m2/reference-mass profiles; tau dimensionless

limits: no app/event/source integration
true finite Gaussian columns withFloat32/erf and finite proxy-tail error; no unbiased-renderer claim
back-to-front latent-centre order; S at optical conditional mean, overlapping/source-varying scattering is approximate
optional four-cell front-air T/S restores front in-scatter at a conditional-mean thin layer; overlapping volumes are not a joint RTE integration
optional shared6 localIncident sources replace legacy2 clusters; borrowed stored RGB is not multiplied by P again
no smoke self-shadow, smoke source-path attenuation or multiple scattering; shared torch scene-shadow PCF is reused when active
air is sun/key-only, exponential height, flat local worldY clamped at0; no smoke/local-light sourced air illumination added by this module
opaque depth must be independently resolved; no centre-depth discard
whole-space Gaussian matches state; no ground-fold/deposition model implicitly applied
no density/P/C coupling; P applied once to own raw lighting including air, borrowed local uniforms must already match this frame P
proxy culling affects rendering only; physical state mass is never deleted
far/subpixel footprint filtering and volumeDOF are not solved; per-source PSF remains caller-owned
Physical transport uses fixed20Hz state commits; it is not a fluid/turbulence/settling solver.
Source-path extinction is queried at emitter/tail anchors; it is not exact per-pixel convolution through a varying medium.
Whole-space neutral Gaussian medium; scattering, overlap order and clear-air folding retain the renderer StageA approximations.

limits: Snapshot coherence, not instantaneous sky; cube/PMREM age are explicit
Sky cubemap is captured at one fixed point per round, not a spatial radiance field

fireworks.model: analytic linear-drag segments; deterministic world-space events; authored reference photometry, not CFD

radianceBound.method: 32x32 conservative source overlap bins; actual pixel-integrated Gaussian peak and projected shutter/stretch extent; near crossings cover viewport; legacy globalFiniteSurfaceCeiling is a spherical reference only; root separately budgets ambient/air/receivers

fireworks.units: reference cd + approximate emission RGB, linear scene reference once *2^storageEV; not measured pyrotechnic photometry
fireworks.renderer: independent instanced premult effects, four-segment finite air; water-hit reflection origin; sorted short segments
limits: linear drag/burn model; no chemical or shock/fluid solve
grey smoke thin sprites; centre-depth sorting and shared near-air visibility approximation
resolved opaque depth/defocus occlusion approximation; root owns one shared bloom/vignette
subpixel tail shutter variance is a bounded angular approximation, not exact time-space convolution
star/cross-spectrum RGB is approximate CIE fit + authored bands and gamut compression

bounds.model: 16-point analytic trajectory forecast at current wind +8m margin; 2Hz cache; smoke envelope
